With the passing days, the world is heading towards a dark time that is full of trials and tribulations. We as Muslim parents are responsible for keeping our kids attached and connected with the book of Allah. The book leads them to the right path which is required to follow if we need to sail safely in times of ambiguity. To proceed with the online Quran classes for kids there are some fundamental aspects that parents should consider before letting their kids embark on the journey of Quran learning. Following are the top 5 points that will help you make the decision.

Professionally Trained online Quran tutor

If you have finally made up your mind, the primary and essential point is to look for a professionally trained online Quran tutor. As you know this learning is going to be virtual and you can’t meet the teacher in person. So, spend some time looking for a qualified Quran teacher. Shortlist the best available teachers and add up their premium points. Hire the one who passes the following criterion.
  • The tutor is a native Arabic and is proficient in teaching the Quran with expertise.
  • The teacher is well-versed in the English language and can teach kids from around the world easily.
  • The Quran tutor who has completed a degree from a reputable institute and has vast experience in teaching and handling kids in online classes.
  • The instructor who is well aware of the latest technology like visual PowerPoint slides, 3D representation, digital handling of classes, etc.

Effective Teaching Techniques to engage kids in the lesson

Parents are advised not to ignore this point as it is highly significant. kids are supposed to have less attention and retention span. They need to switch quickly from one task to another. Only then, they will be engaged in the lesson they are learning. If the teachers are successfully devising effective and efficient teaching techniques to make learning the Quran for kids online easy and interesting, then you can confidently give them a chance. These innovative techniques include:
  • Fun-oriented and highly interactive Quran learning classes.
  • Repetition of every lesson.
  • Audio/video aid to make lessons engaging.
  • Interactive sessions to let kids be more confident.
  • Guess games and riddles to make Quran lessons easy.
  • Poems and Nasheeds to make learning enjoyable for kids, etc.

The activity-based curriculum of online Quran classes

If you have short-listed the platform for your kids’ Quran learning classes, then make sure they are providing an activity-based curriculum. The need for such a syllabus is that it engages the students and never lets them lose their interest. Secondly, both parents and teachers are responsible for inculcating the love and devotion of Islam and the Quran in the hearts of these minors. If the instructors keep on teaching the Quran without any activity, kids will get bored and maybe they won’t enjoy their Hifz, Tajweed, Recitation, Islamic studies, and other lessons. So, select wisely and opt for a curriculum that is exactly age-appropriate, activity-based, and engaging at the same time.

Cost-effective and pocket-friendly budget for the course

This point also holds great importance due to several reasons. Firstly, everyone has to keep the economic inflation in mind which is playing a big role nowadays. Secondly, choose someone who is reliable, reputable, and affordable at the same time. Already you will save much of the amount that was supposed to be used for fuel, uniform, stationery, etc. if you were to enroll your kids in Quran classes in any institute. Online Quran learning makes things very easy and cost-effective. So, look out for an affordable package that can help you achieve the goal easily.

Flexible Class Timings

If you want your kids to learn the Quran online, ensure that you have the option of desired class time. Many of the online Quran platforms offer flexible timings to make learning easy. A flexible schedule has numerous benefits for learning. Such as:
  • It lets parents keep a check on their kids.
  • Kids can focus more in that desired time.
  • Parents can get free from their work to give some time to the kids if they need any help, etc.

Proper revisions and Tests conducted during the course

Keep the fact in mind that the Quran cannot be learned without regular revisions and tests. If your kids do not revise and repeat their lessons daily, slowly and gradually they will start forgetting it. Be it the Quran memorization, or recitation with Tajweed. Be it the lesson from Basic Qaida, or stories from Islamic history. Every category needs revision. Validate that the teacher is taking oral or written tests daily to keep a check on lesson retention. Tests don’t mean they should be a lengthy exam paper, it can be anything like:
  • Quiz
  • Hint games
  • Riddles
  • Oral questioning
  • Fill the blanks
  • Choose the correct answers from the pictures
  • Color the right answer, etc.

Regular Feedback and meeting policies with parents.

Quran classes for kids would be successful if the parents were getting regular feedback from the teachers. To keep parents aware of the ongoing progress, online meeting policies play a significant role. The parents should keep in touch with the teacher and discuss everything about their kids like errors in pronunciation, Tajweed, focus span, carelessness, or anything that needs to be dealt with. Conclusion In a nutshell, these are some of the key points that parents should not ignore before starting online Quran classes for their kids. These classes are meant to bring drastic changes in the learning process of the kids. It enables them to connect and devote themselves to the book of Allah at a young age so that they can continue making it better and stronger with age.
